meta.source: Mobile 100% Inspection clickable prototype v3 (app.src.html), palette direction grey / white / blue accent from the product owner, 15 Oct 2026

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background: white. The page and the header strip.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Very light grey panes on the white app: PO list column, Top 5 area, results box, shoe-map pane.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Rows, cards, buttons and dialogs inside the grey panes.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, field fills, the context strip above a list.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons, commands, pills and dialogs (3:1 on bg, panel, surface and surface-sunken).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Black is for text only: body text, labels, numbers, on bg, panel, surface and surface-sunken. Never a fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, leader lines, field captions, on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: metadata, sub-lines, placeholders, on any surface or bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: selected items (PO, shoe area, current crumb), the active inspection type, the primary action (SUBMIT PO, LOGIN), count badges, links. As text on bg, surface, panel or accent-soft.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Pressed state of white controls, the tap flash, rows that just changed; accent or ink text on it.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Grey fill of any disabled button, command, row or pill (darker than panel). Disabled controls turn grey; they don't fade.

tokens.name: on-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the disabled fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px solid; at least 3:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: minor
tokens.usage: MINOR classification text, on minor-soft.

tokens.name: minor-soft
tokens.usage: MINOR chip fill.

tokens.name: major
tokens.usage: MAJOR classification text, on major-soft.

tokens.name: major-soft
tokens.usage: MAJOR chip fill.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: CRITICAL chip fill (solid, the only solid classification).

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text on the critical fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Sent / photo attached state, as text or a 2px border on surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting / incomplete state text, on surface or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Notice fill for warnings (missing photos, unsent POs).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed state and destructive text on surface; dashed 'Foto wajib' border; danger button fill.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (LOGOUT).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and pickers.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: action-xl
styles.usage: The full-width ADD DEFECT bar. Uppercase.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Result values and Top 5 quantities. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: action
styles.usage: Buttons, inspection commands, dialog titles. Uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Stat labels, area pills, crumbs. Uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field captions and meta labels. Uppercase, ink-3.

styles.name: field
styles.usage: Picker values on the login screen.

styles.name: option
styles.usage: Sub-area and family rows in the drill-down. Uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text, notices, dialog body.

styles.name: defect
styles.usage: Defect names exactly as DEFECT_LIST writes them (mixed case kept).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Sub-lines under a row: area path, counts, times. ink-3.

styles.name: po
styles.usage: PO numbers in the PO list (italic, as in the wireframe).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: PO numbers and codes inside meta lines and headers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a chip and its text, icon and label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling buttons; row inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row inner horizontal padding; gap inside panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; the minimum side gutter of the app.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; space between panel groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Login form padding on large tablets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, status badges, the qty box in a row, breadcrumbs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inspection commands, picker fields, area pills, photo buttons, toasts, notices, bottom-bar buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panes, lists of rows (List), the results box, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Round count badges.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable height and width, everywhere.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a drill-down or Top 5 row.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Picker fields and the header strip.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: BACK / HOME / UNDO bar and the ADD DEFECT bar.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, pickers, dropdown panels and toasts only. Nothing on the page itself casts a shadow.
